newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas strengthens in winter as 500 lots trade.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas strengthens in winter as 500 lots trade.

text.p: The recent resurgence in IPE natural gas futures continued on Tuesday as 500 lots were traded in nine of the contract's 12 months.
This is the highest volume since April 15, when 525 lots were traded. The record volume, set on February 19, is 575 lots.

The most active period was the winter, with 100 lots done in both January and February. Winter prices were higher, with January trading up to 18.40 pence a therm, up 0.16 pence from Monday's settlement level, while February reached 18.425 pence, up 0.15 pence.
Prices were mixed, with December and April slipping while the other seven traded months rose. But some of the prices movements were small, with four months seeing changes of 0.05 pence or less.

Front month August expired at the close of business, but was untraded. Its closing bid/offer range was 9.30/9.60 pence, and there were a total of 25 lots done on an Exchange for Physical basis in August.
